text:
Predicates:
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
CreatedBy(x, y) ::: x was created by y.
Japanese(y) ::: y is a Japanese company.
OnTop10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillion(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
IncludedInTop10(x) ::: x is included in the Top 10 list.
Premises:
∀x (OnTop10(x) → ∃y (CreatedBy(x, y) ∧ Japanese(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanOneMillion(x) → IncludedInTop10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it is included in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillion(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
OnTop10(theLegendOfZelda)
